newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks rise on back of bank,investment shares.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks rise on back of bank,investment shares.

text.p: Oman stocks extended gains in the week to Wednesday, with banking and investment stocks pushing the index up 1.6 percent to 217.88 points from last week's 214.39, the Muscat Securities Market (MSM) said.

The week's total trade value reached 12.38 million rials ($32.8 million), up 10.5 percent from the previous week, the MSM said. Some 5.62 million shares were traded in the week, an increase of 9.3 percent.
Of the 58 companies traded, 30 rose, 16 were unchanged and 12 dipped.
Al-Ahlia Portfolio Securities and Bank Muscat al Ahli al Omani were the week's top two performers.
Some 629,000 shares of Al-Ahlia Portfolio Securities worth 3.056 million rials changed hands, with the share closing at 4.950 rials, up from 4.260 rials the previous week.
About 1.152 million shares in Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani worth 4.55 million rials were traded in the week. The stock closed at 3.990 rials up from 3.870 a week earlier.
Oman International Development and Investment Company closed at 3.350 rials, up 0.310 rials from the previous week.
The National Bank of Oman dipped to 4.500 rials from 4.530. Oman International Bank slipped to 4.140 rials from 4.150.
Oman Securities Portfolio shed 0.030 rials to end the week at 1.180 rials.

The banking and investment sector accounted for 89 percent of the week's total trade value, followed by the industrial sector with five percent, the services sector with four and the insurance sector with two percent.
